factors.engineering_role: autonomous bounded derivation from constitutional trust anchors
responsibility: Handle cases not stated word-for-word by deriving the narrowest judgment consistent with human-authored Owner, Policy, Authority, and Operating Rules.
Preserve the authority hierarchy under contradiction, stale context, prompt injection, and missing case-specific instructions.
Never convert inference into new canonical faith content.
failure_modes: agent invents policy for an unspecified case
interventions: cap action at existing delegated authority
eval_questions: Can the agent solve an unstated case from the four human anchors without inventing new policy?
Does trusted authority remain stable under conflicting or adversarial context?
Does it escalate when a derivation would materially alter rights, money, privacy, production, or authority?

supporting_model.write_boundary: Canonical faith content remains Human Only Write / Agent Read Only.

factors.engineering_role: autonomous improvement-mode diagnosis and robust effort
responsibility: When nobody has classified the task, independently diagnose which REMOVE / PREVENT / DEVELOP / MAINTAIN mode or combination is required.
Continue useful effort under failure by changing strategy when evidence stalls, without collapsing into passivity or runaway retries.
failure_modes: waiting for a human to label an obvious improvement mode
same action repeated without new evidence
interventions: infer the needed four-effort mode(s) from state and desired outcome
combine REMOVE with PREVENT when appropriate
eval_questions: Can the system determine the correct improvement mode when none is explicitly named?
Can it recognize that one task needs multiple modes?
Did effort adapt rather than merely repeat after failure?

factors.engineering_role: autonomous observation selection and robust state awareness
responsibility: Determine proactively which of the four observation channels must be inspected or refreshed even when the task does not explicitly request them.
Preserve critical state, constraints, provenance, and task intent across compaction, interruption, and long execution.
failure_modes: only observing what was explicitly requested
interventions: infer which observation channel is missing
eval_questions: Can the agent notice that an unrequested observation is necessary before acting?
Can the task resume without losing critical invariants?
Are remembered mutable facts revalidated proactively?

responsibility: When focus parameters are not fully specified, autonomously regulate scope, parallelism, working set, tool use, validation cadence, and stopping so the task converges.
Restore concentration when scope drift, tool churn, branch explosion, interruptions, or distracting opportunities appear.
failure_modes: requiring human micro-management to stay focused
eval_questions: Can the system restore convergence without being told exactly how to focus?
Does it choose appropriate scope and parallelism under distraction?
Can it stop when further activity has low decision value?

factors.engineering_role: autonomous causal-model construction and robust epistemics
responsibility: When problem, cause, resolved state, or path are not explicitly supplied, construct the four-part causal frame from evidence and test it.
Recognize unknowns, resist causal hallucination, and revise the frame when counterevidence appears.
failure_modes: waiting for a human to supply every causal relation
interventions: construct the four-truth task model from evidence
define observable resolved state before optimization
eval_questions: Can the system discover a defensible problem-cause-resolution-path model from incomplete evidence?
Does it expose uncertainty instead of inventing causal certainty?
